title: India-oriented Phone Series Design Judgment 0.5.0 Candidate

market_context.const: 2026 India-oriented mainstream to upper-mid smartphone series

series_scope.const: Base, Standard, Pro, and India Edition

reference_role.const: directional evidence for retail-distance recognition and youthful CMF; never a geometry to copy

silhouette.const: tall large-screen slab with believable medium volume

corner_family.const: moderate continuous soft-square radii shared by body, display, and camera enclosure

frame_and_grip.const: flat central rail with softened contact chamfers and one coherent rear transition

camera_location.const: one upper horizontal camera enclosure with clear top and side margins

primary_mass.const: full rounded left main-camera body flowing into a gently tapered right tail

optical_axis.const: every real lens centre and the flash centre share one horizontal axis

main_camera.const: largest protected ring at the rounded left anchor

auxiliary_cameras.const: true supplied lenses only, descending clearly in scale toward the right

flash.const: one visibly smaller pill or dot at the far tapered tail, subordinate to every lens

forbidden.const: no fake aperture, decorative sensor, repeated filler, random vertical offset, camera text, display, or active light

body.const: one rigid horizontal enclosure rather than a soft patch or generic black visor

segmentation.const: at most one hard-part seam separating the main-camera anchor from the auxiliary tail

elevation.const: one shallow enclosure elevation plus protected lens rings

junction.const: a precise seam or narrow shadow gap visibly proves attachment to the rigid rear surface

substrate_logic.const: rear, camera enclosure, and frame all read as compatible rigid parts

junction_logic.const: material changes follow one rigid part seam, controlled step, or finish boundary; never an unresolved faux-soft and hard-part collision

reflectivity_hierarchy.const: optical glass high reflection, lens rings and hard enclosure medium reflection, broad rear surface low reflection

abstracted_relationship.const: a full rounded body flows directionally into a tapered tip and restrained continuous curl

primary_carrier.const: the horizontal enclosure outer flow and its single hard-part seam

supporting_carrier.const: directional microtexture, clear-coat light flow, or one non-repeating micro-engraved field on the rigid rear

camera_clearance.const: cultural lines and texture terminate around every lens and flash; they never cross, place, disguise, or compete with functional hardware

Standard.const: enclosure flow plus low-contrast directional microtexture

Pro.const: enclosure flow plus precise transparent-layer light flow

India Edition.const: enclosure flow plus one readable non-repeating micro-engraved Paisley field

member_hero.const: each member receives one Phone Dual-View Hero with exactly two consistent views of that member and colourway

comparison_consistency.const: all four heroes share framing, projection character, occupancy, and lighting softness

background_separation.const: each backdrop differs from its phone in both luminance and hue so the complete silhouette remains distinct

supplied_hardware.const: two real rear cameras and one flash
three real rear cameras and one flash
three real rear cameras with an enlarged main camera and one flash
the Standard member's three real rear cameras and one flash
